# Available recall evidence and bounds

**Production-equivalent end-to-end precision, recall and the routing-recall cost of grace shortening are unmeasured.** These are conditional fixed-target proxy bounds, not a sequential replay, a product across populations, or bounds on full-cohort production routing.

Anchor: 94 SOL-quoted copy targets with stored historical reads. Under the earliest-observed-SOL-member creation proxy, 86 are inside the 1 h grace and 8 are outside it. A real room could have an unobserved earlier ancestor. The reserve proxy sums independent pump curves; it is not observed reserve of the proposed shared room.

| proxy gate variant | 1 h retention lower–upper | 2 h retention lower–upper | older targets recovered lower–upper | lost targets lower–upper | loss in retention points lower–upper |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| without volume | 86/94–91/94 (91.49%–96.81%) | 94/94–94/94 | 0–5 | 3–8 | 3.19–8.51 |
| with volume | 86/94–91/94 (91.49%–96.81%) | 94/94–94/94 | 0–5 | 3–8 | 3.19–8.51 |

A below-floor reserve sum is conclusive for this proxy only when every relevant member has a confirmed trade snapshot and quote coverage is complete. Non-trade/missing reads contain zero placeholders and are unknown, not proof of an empty curve. This is why the former point proxy cannot be reported as an observed routing-recall cost.

Full signatures, member identifiers, read slots and classification details are in recall_bounds.json. No mature target is verified to pass reserve/idle in this subset, so none can be identified as a proven volume-only rejection. Volume could still affect the indeterminate targets; the data cannot determine whether it does.

The same fixed-target age proxy alone permits recovery of any outside-grace target in a hypothetical real room. That looser sensitivity interval is not a production recall bound either: live-gate decisions alter subsequent room formation, target identities and ties. The full cohort cannot inherit the subset bounds without an explicit extrapolation, which is not used as the headline.

To measure it later, collect room/door and SlugLock state at the replay boundary; ordered per-room reserve, status and last-trade updates; every gross-volume increment needed to rebuild trailing buckets; pool identity and cumulative LP-fee checkpoint history after graduation; and actual routing/first-buy events. Preserve slots, transaction indices within slots, timestamps and configuration versions. A pump-only backfill additionally needs an explicit, disclosed pump-to-room proxy. More launch metadata or a longer metadata-only window does not provide these state histories.
